note: Adjudicated accidental variants. The digital source's closing Alleluia belongs to the Mass of 8 May and is declared as a recension difference in its witness file.

adjudicated.ruling: The typical edition sets no accent on a capital letter. The edition restores the accent on a capitalized word of three or more syllables (ORTHOGRAPHY.md, rule 4).
The typical edition sets a comma after dícite (p. 685) and the edition follows it.
The digital source continues with the Paschaltide Alleluia. The typical edition ends the communion here with a full stop (p. 685).
